close_reason: Fixed: Email 16 now says '50-byte body (smallest of the three sort-test emails)' — absolute not relative
description: Email 16 comment says 'smallest body in Folder B' but Email 7 (large-email, >10 KB) is also in Folder B — making the claim technically accurate only if the reader knows Email 16 means the smallest of the sort-test triple, not smallest of all Folder B emails. A contributor adding a new small email to Folder B would not realise they need to update this comment.
title: seed.rs Email 16: 'smallest body in Folder B' is ambiguous
